items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Guard stays silent while a launched background reviewer or shell is unfinished; no throttle on an open PR (a silent Stop ends the turn, so it was rejected); docs, contract and module docstring match.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unparsable, missing or future timestamps never silence the guard; a poison transcript line is skipped; a task that never reports stops counting after its bound (2 h agent, 30 min shell).

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new inputs beyond transcript JSON parsed with json.loads in try/except and one anchored regex; no shell.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Background tracking tested on launch/terminal/non-terminal/false-launch/persistent monitor/same-line notice/age bound/future timestamp/pruning/incremental scan/poison line/decide/blocker preserved/real hook subprocess.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The scan stays incremental; tracking adds substring checks per line and pruning only on a launch.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New iterate_stop_guard_background.py (about 100 lines); guard module under the 300-line limit.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Transcript launch toolUseResult and task-notification (tool-use-id, status) formats verified against real transcripts on disk.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No tests skipped or weakened; one tuple unpack widened for the new Scan field.
